Question: There is a smallest positive real number \(a\) such that there exists a positive real number \(b\) such that all the roots of the polynomial \(x^3-ax^2+bx-a\) are real. In fact, for this value of \(a\) the value of \(b\) is unique. What is this value of \(b?\)
